# Test Fixtures (`tests/fixtures/`)

This directory contains deterministic, synthetic test data used by unit tests to avoid external network or dataset dependencies.

## Fixtures

| File | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `sample_pairs.jsonl` | 10-row toy dataset (5 questions × 2 pairs each: supported + hallucinated), covering dev and test splits across multiple difficulty levels (easy, medium, hard). |

---
*Research prototype. Not for clinical use.*
